name: Snizoshla s Nebes: Ispytaniye Vremenem
source:
This is one of the stories that happened to the protagonist of the Descended from Heaven mod during those 30 undescribed, mysterious cycles...
What will he choose: abandon all pathetic attempts to find his one and only, or remain true to his feelings and hope that somewhere out there, at the end of the tunnel, there will be light?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1766597219]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是《天堂降临》模组主角在这30个未描述的神秘循环中发生的故事之一……
他会选择什么：放弃所有寻找他唯一的可悲的尝试，还是忠于自己的感受并希望在隧道尽头的某个地方会有光明？

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1766597219]Steam[/url]]
